c.tagline: A pine-backed marina town on the Turquoise Coast, famous for its lively bar street and gulet-boat harbor
langs: German and Russian (common due to European tourism)

card: Widely accepted at hotels, restaurants, and marina shops; small stalls and bars on Bar Street may prefer cash.
rides: dolmuş minibuses to Içmeler and Turunç

taxi.fare: Roughly ₺30-50 flag fall plus metered per-km rate
taxi.fareNote: Metered fares are standard in town; agree a flat rate for trips to Içmeler or Turunç

english.label: Easy to get by in English

walk: The marina, castle, and Bar Street are all within walking distance in central Marmaris; Içmeler, Turunç, and Dalyan require a dolmuş, taxi, or boat.

safety.safety: Very safe for solo travelers; Marmaris is a well-established resort town, though Bar Street can get rowdy late at night in peak summer season
safety.crime: Petty theft (unattended bags on the beach or in bars) is the main risk; standard nightlife precautions apply on Bar Street

hood_landmark.Marmaris Marina / Old Town: Marmaris Castle and the yacht marina
hood_landmark.Bar Street: Marmaris's dense strip of bars and clubs
hood_landmark.Uzunyalı: Long beach hotel strip along the bay

avoid.reason: Nightlife scams (padded bar bills) and drink-spiking; jet-ski damage scams

hood_desc: The historic core around the 16th-century castle and yacht marina, with the Grand Bazaar and waterfront restaurants.
Marmaris's famously lively nightlife strip, packed with bars, clubs, and late-night food stalls — the town's loudest district after dark.
A calmer beach resort suburb a short dolmuş ride south, popular with families and couples seeking a quieter base.
A pine-backed cove village further along the peninsula, reached by boat or a scenic coastal road, known for clear water and a relaxed pace.
The long hotel-lined beach strip stretching east from the marina, home to many of Marmaris's larger resort properties.

water.note: Tap water is chlorinated but not recommended — drink bottled like the locals.

transit.sys: Dolmuş (shared minibus) network connecting Marmaris to Içmeler, Turunç, and outlying villages
transit.map: Dolmuş depart from the main Marmaris otogar near the marina
transit.note: Boat trips to Cleopatra Island and along the coast are a popular way to explore

transport.air: Dalaman Airport (DLM), about 95 km away, has direct flights from Istanbul and seasonal international routes
transport.bus: Overnight coaches connect Marmaris to Istanbul, Izmir, and other Turkish cities via the otogar
transport.ferry: Seasonal ferries connect Marmaris to Rhodes, Greece
transport.car: Self-driving is popular for exploring Dalyan, Turunç, and the coastal villages independently

airport.name: Dalaman Airport
airport.transport: Havaş shuttle buses and pre-booked hotel transfers; taxi transfer roughly $60-80

net.m: Good 4G/5G coverage in Marmaris and along the coast
net.w: Free wifi standard in hotels and cafes
net.fwn: Free wifi widely available in hotels and marina cafes
net.ap: A Turkcell or Vodafone tourist SIM or eSIM is recommended

tip.s: 10% is customary for tour guides and boat crews
tip.r: 10% is standard at restaurants where service isn't already included
